citation.quote: This 24-month, full-time program leads to a Master of Science in Cardiovascular Perfusion degree and begins each year in the summer semester (early May).
Master of Science in Cardiovascular Perfusion

The cardiovascular perfusion program is a 24-month (6-semester), post-baccalaureate degree that begins each year in early May and is delivered in two main phases: a didactic phase focused on intensive classroom and laboratory instruction, followed by a clinical phase featuring full-time rotations at leading hospitals across the United States.
How many students are you accepting each year? - 10 students

Kirk Bingham MS, CCP
University of Utah
CVP Program Director
Cardiovascular Perfusionist
The initial year is dedicated to on-campus, in-person didactic and simulation training at the University of Utah.

The University of Utah Cardiovascular Perfusion Program is accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (www.caahep.org) upon the recommendation of the Accreditation Committee-Perfusion Education (http://www.ac-pe.org/).
